newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian peso ends soft,banks build dlr positions.
newsitem.headline: Colombian peso ends soft,banks build dlr positions.

text.p: Colombia's peso dipped 0.75 peso to 1,063.35 against the dollar as banks looked to build up dollar positions, traders said.

Some dealers said banks oversold dollars expecting a large influx of greenbacks which never materialized. Other traders, however, said there was a significant entry of petro-dollars and private investment cash.
Dealers reported 352 trades worth a total $142 million. The peso opened at the low of 1,061.8 and sank to an intraday low of 1,063.5.
